candidates.title: THREAD WEAVE
candidates.description: Draw one continuous non-crossing line to link a set of moving nodes; the route order you choose determines which links complete.

candidates.title: SORT SPIN
candidates.description: Drag falling items into one of several rotating bins whose accepted color keeps shifting, requiring you to predict bin position and timing.

candidates.title: DIAL LOCK
candidates.description: Drag around a circular dial's rim to rotate it onto a shifting target angle, choosing rotation speed and exact stop timing.

candidates.title: TETHER SWING
candidates.description: Drag to wind a hanging weight into pendulum motion, then release at the right arc phase to fling it into a moving basket, with leftover momentum carrying into the next swing.

candidates.title: GRAFT LINE
candidates.description: Drag links between glowing nodes to grow a network, choosing which pairs to connect before any node overloads from too many links.

candidates.title: FOLD CREASE
candidates.description: Drag a corner of a paper shape across a crease to fold it, choosing which corner and how far to fold to match a rotating target silhouette.

candidates.title: RING RUNNER
candidates.description: Drag to sweep a runner around a fixed ring, choosing where to be as multiple falling pods approach from different angles so only the ones you're under get caught.

candidates.title: RIVER CUT
candidates.description: Drag to carve a permanent channel through sand that redirects a flowing stream, with each cut constraining where later channels can go.

candidates.title: KNOT PULL
candidates.description: Drag to pull one loop of a tightening knot at a time, choosing which loop loosens the whole knot versus which tightens it further.

candidates.title: KITE LINE
candidates.description: Drag to steer a wind-drifting kite through a sequence of gates, choosing lead angles to counter gusts before each gate.

candidates.title: RAIL SWITCH
candidates.description: Drag track-switch levers to route several simultaneously moving carts onto color-matched branches, choosing which switch to flip and when before a cart passes it.

candidates.title: SPOOL WIND
candidates.description: Continuously drag in circles to reel in a hooked line against tension, choosing when to sustain versus pause across multiple simultaneous lines before one snaps.

reason: RING RUNNER scores highest overall by combining the clearest 60-second readability and most reliable single-file implementability (C2/C4/C5/C6) of the three finalists with a genuinely novel single-degree-of-freedom multi-target prioritization decision (C1/C3) that deepens as pod density and precision demands ramp up (C7), whereas RIVER CUT and THREAD WEAVE score slightly higher on raw novelty but carry more implementation risk.
